clean_story:
Now I will teach you Pain. Pain is like fire touching skin, but inside. It is sharp like stone cutting, or heavy like big rock on foot. It comes when body is hurt, like when beast bites or thorn pokes. It makes you pull back, like hand from hot coal. It is body's way to say stop, be careful. This is Pain.

Discover now hurt, ache, and life.
